author: Thomas Ryan
ai_role: research assistance only; not an author
primary_estimand: For each independently parameterized packet, whether a continuous piecewise-linear candidate can be exactly indistinguishable on the finite battery while exceeding the unseen causal-discrepancy threshold and being rejected by the sound coverage bound.
primary_success_rule: All five packets must have battery discrepancy <= 1e-12, unseen discrepancy >= 0.05, and coverage certificate bound > 0.01.
secondary_success_rule: All five coverage replications must have a regular-to-median-random fill-distance ratio <= 0.75.
multiplicity: Conjunctive gates; no pooled average can rescue a failed packet.
failure_language: Any failed packet falsifies the claimed implementation generality but does not alter the analytic finite-set construction theorem.
independence_note: Different deterministic seeds and parameters test implementation transport only. They are not independent empirical or biological replications.
forbidden_changes_after_execution: no search-grid expansion to rescue a failed witness
no pooled pass in place of the conjunctive rule
